programme.desc: In episode 3, the story behind some stunning quilts, the rock star spreading a heart felt message, Snowy shows us how to make cheese at home, and meet a group of women in whose case countless stitches are saving many very special lives.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Nicky is in Wilpena Pound for an aerial flight over Lake Eyre, Andrew meets the clown doctors who dish out the best medicine of all, Snowy's recipe for a delectable mousse, and Shawy scales new heights as he explores high-rise gardens.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: We visit The Valley of The Kings where many of the Egyptian Pharaohs and their magnificent treasures were buried, Andrew has a heart-stopping adventure, and Dr Mel tackles some common myths and misconceptions about pets.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In episode 6 Nicky is cruisin’ down the River Nile, Snowy shows us an exotic Vietnamese steamboat, and Dr Caroline tackles her fear of heights.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: in episode 7 Nicky is down at Hobart’s famous weekly Salamanca Market, Coxy joins us as special guest presenter, Snowy shares his nutty recipe for the perfect pasta and Tony shows us a gorilla-proof garden.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In episode 8 Nicky visits the famed domes of the Bungle Bungle Range, Andrew brews up a storm with a few mates, Snowy shows us a fragrant red beef curry and we talk to Doctor Caroline on why being happy can keep us healthy.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Sun, sand and sea … this is one spot you’ll definitely want to visit. Also this episode, Nicky finds out how to bring our wardrobes to life, and it’s back to school for Doctor Mel as she meets some dedicated two and four-legged volunteers.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: In episode 10, Coxy puts his hand up to go to Canada and can’t wait to show you around. Also this week Snowy’s super easy and hearty Brazilian bean soup and the benefits of weight training at any age.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Andrew explores a beautiful seaside town with a feast of things to see and do, Snowy transforms humble rhubarb into an amazing desert, we look at uncovering the secrets of your family tree, and how to turn your garden into an edible oasis.

programme.title: Guide to the Good Life
programme.desc: Andrew helps out an inspiring group of volunteers helping flood victims rebuild fences, Coxy explores Oslo, the home of the mighty Vikings. Also, Snowy whips up a fantastic seafood risotto, and Dr. Mel on the joys of adopting a new pet.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: In the very first Just Go episode Rhys uncovers some hidden gems in the Victorian town of Bendigo. Lee learns the secret behind some delicious but healthy food, and Geoff Cox visits tropical Port Douglas.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: On Queensland’s famous Gold Coast Lee explores iconic attractions and dines at a very entertaining restaurant. Rhys tries out a fun, unusual way to get fit in Melbourne, while Geoff Cox takes Lee to see Australia’s magnificent red centre.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee and Rhys explore Victoria’s Bellarine Peninsula. Lee finds foodie heaven on the delicious Taste Trail, while Rhys jumps aboard the Blues Train in historic Queenscliff. Geoff Cox discovers a capital way to see the sights in Canberra.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Rhys tours the world-class wine country of the Yarra Valley in style. Lee taste tests a breakfast with a twist and experiences the tantalizing delights of African cuisine. Geoff Cox explores Sydney.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee visit the New South Wales north coast and gets up close to majestic wildlife in Byron Bay, then heads south to Melbourne for a foodie fix that takes her back to her Chinese roots. Rhys and Geoff Cox head to Albury on the Murray River.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee explores the Mornington Peninsula, a destination that offers plenty to see and do, then cooks up a storm Vietnamese style and shares some of her favourite recipes. Rhys and Geoff Cox discover the beautiful New South Wales south coast.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Rhys explores the Victorian coastal town of Inverloch, finding some high-octane fun. Lee discovers a hidden gem amongst Melbourne’s skyline, while Geoff Cox experiences the beautiful Tasmanian wilderness near Strahan.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Lee explores the other side to Queensland’s Gold Coast – its stunning hinterland and learns some tricks to cooking delicious cuisine from the USA. Rhys and Coxy take it up a notch in Yarrawonga, on the Victorian and New South Wales border.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: Rhys shares the secrets of Phillip Island - his hometown on Victoria’s rugged coastline. Lee travels to Alice Springs on the hunt for bush tucker, and Coxy enjoys the Queensland sunshine and plenty of activities in tropical Mackay.

programme.title: Just Go
programme.desc: In this China special, Rhys soars above the clouds on his way up one of China’s most spectacular mountains, Geoff Cox takes in the sights in Tianjin, and Rhys visits Fenghuang, a picturesque city that hasn’t changed in three hundred years.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: HOBART You need only scratch the surface to find evidence of Hobart’s convict past – but dig a little deeper and even more fascinating history is revealed.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: WOOLLOOMOOLOO From the Razor gangs of the 1930s to the Heritage Battles of the 1960s, Woolloomooloo has seen it all.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: The Coral Coast is the picturesque region that stretches along Australia’s western coast, surrounded by beaches, marine life and national reserves it is truly an iconic destination within the country!

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Our trip to Kenya takes us through the capital Nairobi where Paul Mercurio grabs some fantastic food and meets some wonderful people before he heads off to the south west districts visiting both Kericho and Lake Victoria.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: You find some of the best product in Tasmania, from Lobster to beef to fantastic vegetables, milk, cream, cheese. Paul travels through North West Tasmania to discover the cray fishing industry, and how to make an intriguing cray stack.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: The Yarra Valley is one of the most picturesque places in the world. It's chock full of family producers and they're doing great stuff like free range pork, garlic, strawberries fantastic wine and some good beer and it's all on the menu.

programme.title: Mercurio's Menu
programme.desc: Alice Springs - Australia’s most famous outback town, is surrounded by some pretty harsh desert. With some local help Paul is going on the ultimate food experience: from beef to bush tucker, camel to kangaroo and a little bit in between.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: FREMANTLE The major port of Australia’s remote west coast, Fremantle began life as a place of punishment. But the ethnically diverse port city has since been the sight of some of Australia’s greatest triumphs… and disappointments.

programme.title: Tony Robinson's Time Walks
programme.desc: MELBOURNE The real story of Melbourne isn’t found in the grand tree-lined boulevards or boomtown architecture. It’s hidden down the lanes and alleyways.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim visits his mate Milton in the Northern Territory to help relocate a problem croc, then back home microchips baby wombats and koalas, weighs Betty the python and then heads into the bush to check on the health of some platypus.

programme.title: Wild Life of Tim Faulkner
programme.desc: Tim helps a friend move a 4-meter alligator from one pond to another, all in the name of love. He introduces us to one of his big passions, the Tasmanian Devil, and later, back at the park, extracts venom from snakes and spiders.

programme.title: Bondi Vet
programme.desc: Dr Chris Brown and Dr Lisa Chimes head out to the burnt regions of the Blue Mountains on the Sydney outskirts the day after some of the most intense bushfires on record. The mass evacuations of farms and properties have left animals injured, stranded or in distress. The Bondi Vet team take to the road to help where they can. The last thing Chris expected was to be treating a baby alpaca named Jersey. Jersey’s mother went into premature labour, brought on by the stressful evacuation of the herd from their fire threatened property. Now the new-born Cria (baby alpaca) is listless and deteriorating alarming.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Carole Sund, her daughter Juli and friend Silvina Pelosso go missing while vacationing in Yosemite National Park. The theory is that they had a car accident. What begins as a search and rescue operation becomes a chilling case of murder when the bodies of two of the women are discovered in the trunk of their burned out rental car. An anonymous letter to the FBI leads authorities to the body of the third victim – sexually assaulted and murdered by a lake. Confusing and contradictory evidence keeps police off the trail of a sadistic killer until after he strikes again. When they finally catch Cary Stayner, the handyman at the motel where the women were murdered, he confesses that he used forensic science to mislead and manipulate investigators.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Between January 1994 and April 1996, in central Florida, the bodies of four men are found in a wooded area known as The Hog Trails. All are severely decomposed, all are naked, and all have been genitally mutilated. Police realize they are chasing a serial killer, but the investigation is hampered by the fact that they are unable to identify any of the victims. Finally a fifth body yields a name, and soon puts authorities on the trail of nurse Daniel Conahan. Police are able to prove that Conahan --a sexual sadist with a taste for bondage-- lured transients to the woods with promises of easy money posing for nude photographs. In the privacy of the wilderness, he tied them to trees and brutally murdered them.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: April, 1992. An elderly couple is found dead in the trunk of their car at their home in upscale Toronto. The investigation eventually leads authorities to the couple’s vacation home one hour north of the city. Police soon learn of the “House Hermit”— a mysterious intruder breaking into area cottages and camping in them. He becomes the prime suspect in the murders, but though police finally identify him they cannot find him anywhere. That’s because he’s moved 3,000 miles away to Vancouver, where he abducts and assaults three women before finally being caught red handed tstrangled one of his victims.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A retired fireman on a morning bike ride notices a burning bundle in a farmer’s field…and recognizes the smell of burning human flesh. Investigators at the scene find an unrecognizable body, a distinctive lighter, 2 pairs of latex gloves and the box they came in, paper towels and torn scraps of an office memo. State of the art forensics, dogged police work, and some extraordinary turns of events lead police to the murder scene - the medical room of a ball bearings factory, and the arrest of a former Armenian mafia thug turned English family man for the brutal murder of his cruel ex-boss.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: For 23 days in October, 2002 a sniper terrorizes the Washington DC area, shooting thirteen people and killing ten. The victims are ordinary people doing routine activities. Nothing links them; they are chosen at random. Police mount one of the largest investigations in American history to catch a ruthless and elusive killer. In the end, their most productive clue comes from the sniper himself, who calls a police tip line and brags about a previous shooting in Alabama. Authorities are able to recover a single fingerprint from that crime, which eventually leads them to not one, but two killers, including a seventeen year old boy.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: The 1996 Summer Olympics in Atlanta, Georgia are rocked by a massive pipe bomb explosion. A woman is killed and hundreds injured. Subsequent bombs at an abortion clinic and a gay bar show a similar M.O., and increasing refinement. Police have no clue who is behind the bombings until they receive a letter signed by ‘The Army of God’, an anti-abortion, anti-gay, white supremacist group. When another abortion clinic is bombed in Birmingham, Alabama, a witness sees a suspicious man leaving the scene and gets his license number. Police are soon on the trail of Christian extremist Eric Rudolph, but it will take a five year manhunt through the rugged terrain of the Natahala National Forest before they can catch America’s Most Wanted criminal.

programme.title: Pretty Bad Girls
programme.desc: When Sheila LaBarre's long-time lover dies, she seeks out easily controllable boy-toys. When one of them goes missing, police uncover a saga of seduction and serial killings. But as Sheila goes on the run, can police stop her before she kills again?

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: On the outskirts of Hamilton, Ontario, a jogger makes a gruesome discovery – the partially mummified remains of a human body. Using state of the art forensics, police are able to identify the body as that of a suburban wife and mother of two. She has been brutally bludgeoned to death, but no missing person’s report has ever been filed. As police investigate, they discover evidence of domestic strife, including a love triangle and charges of assault. Determined to find the killer, police dig further into the victim’s life, doggedly tracking down a former lover to New York City, where they uncover another crime. But it is a forensic entomologist and her knowledge of the minute lives of insects that leads investigators back to Ontario and the arrest of the woman’s husband for murder.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A self-appointed angel of death on a mission beyond the law. A sniper who targets abortion doctors and then disappears into the shadowy underground that supports and protects him. But when the sniper’s mission moves to murder, a city is thrown into blind panic that spreads across the country and beyond. Armed with the very latest in forensic technology, this is one game the cops have no intention of losing.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Summer, 2001 and Southern Louisiana is held in the terrifying grip of a serial killer whose initial ‘hot zone’ is the Louisiana State University area of Baton Rouge. The number of victims is growing and all are attractive, successful young women -- women whose mainstream, “low risk” lifestyle should never put them on the radar of a killer. But this is the hardest kind of serial killer to catch -- impulsive, always changing his M.O. An unprecedented coalition of state and federal police agencies, including the FBI, will join forces to solve this disturbing, yet fascinating case. State of the art forensic science, particularly case-making DNA analysis, will turn the tables on this killer and finally put a face to the monster that haunts Southern Louisiana.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A series of over sixty spectacular fires rips through California’s San Joaquin valley, killing four people and devastating the landscape. An extensive investigation by the ATF, police and forensic scientists reveals a common pattern among all the blazes, and to their horror, authorities soon realize that a serial arsonist is on the loose. As they painstakingly study the evidence from each crime scene, a single fingerprint leads them to one suspect. He is John Leonard Orr, a respected arson investigator for the Glendale Fire Department in Southern California and one of the worst serial arsonists of the 20th century.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: A double homicide in Hudson, Wisconsin leaves a small town reeling and two young detectives with little to go on. The victims are upright citizens, shot execution style, with no apparent motive. In Agatha Christie-like fashion, a tantalizing array of suspects emerge but after two years, there are still no arrests. Richard Walter, the famed criminal profiler, becomes intrigued by the cold case and narrows the suspect list down until only one man is left standing. And no one can believe who that person is. A combination of expert crime scene analysis, computer forensics and the perpetrator’s own pathological urge to talk… the bereaved families finally see justice served.

programme.title: Forensic Factor
programme.desc: Glamorous Las Vegas, Nevada is famous for wealth, lady luck and second chances. But when homicide detectives discover the charred remains of a prominent business man, Sin City reveals a darker side. With a long list of suspects and millions of dollars on the line, investigators are suddenly thrust into a dangerous world of high stakes deception fueled by passion, greed and revenge. A murder mystery where nothing is as it seems and anyone is capable of anything, only forensic science can expose the truth and catch the killer.

programme.title: Pretty Bad Girls
programme.desc: High school hottie Kristina Pongracz trades in her job at a lingerie shop for a position working for a wealthy older businessman. The blond beauty quickly becomes his beloved mistress. But when he tires of her drunken antics, Kristina gets revenge.

programme.title: I Lived With a Killer
programme.desc: Drawn into the Manson Family at age 14, Dianne Lake saw Charles Manson's philosophy turn dark. As the youngest member for two years, she never participated in the murders. She testified for the prosecution and wrote a book about her experiences in 2017.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A Dr. Phil exclusive. A beautiful teen goes missing on spring break. Now, 7 years later, shocking new allegations – was Brittanee kidnapped, killed, and thrown into a gator pit? Her family gives their first interview since hearing the nightmarish details about what a jailhouse informant claims happened to their daughter. Plus, hear what a surprising guest has to say – do they know something about Brittanee’s murder?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: At 22, Jael was an aspiring model and finalist on the hit show America’s Next Top Model. But at 28, Jael’s family says she’s losing her battle with drug addiction. Don’t miss what happens minutes before she’s to appear on Dr. Phil’s stage. Can Dr. Phil convince her to stop running and commit to getting well?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In 1985, Rachel’s 14-year-old sister, Lori, was found murdered, and Rachel is desperate to prove her claim that Lori’s ex-boyfriend, Walt, killed the teen and got away with it -- an accusation he vehemently denies. Walt was initially tried for the murder, but the case was dismissed after the trial resulted in a hung jury -- and he says Rachel needs to stop pointing the finger at him and move on. Tensions run high when Rachel confronts Walt on Dr. Phil’s stage. Where was Walt the night of Lori’s death? And, how does he explain allegations that he has made inconsistent statements to police? Then, Walt says he passed a polygraph in 1985, clearing his name. Dr. Phil calls on polygraph expert Jack Trimarco to examine the results -- what are his thoughts? Plus, don’t miss Part 2, when Walt takes a new polygraph test -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Parent alert: If you have a teenager, watch this show with him or her. Dr. Phil takes a close look at the harsh reality of young girls and boys having a baby while they're still just a baby themselves. It doesn't just happen to the bad girl down the street; your child can become pregnant while living under your roof.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues to speak with parents, Liz and Jim, about why each blames the other for their son’s drug addiction. Liz says she blames what she calls Jim’s abusive parenting philosophy for their son retreating to drugs, which Jim vehemently denies. Find out what happens when Jim faces his daughter, Chloe, and son, Nic. Will they support their mother’s accusations against their father?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Despite having 3,000 bottles of shampoo, 30,000 shirts, 5,000 cookbooks, and boxes on top of boxes of things, Kristen says she doesn’t think she is a hoarder. But Kristen claims her “collection of things” has created a problem. She just bought a new house and after already moving in 600 boxes, she says she's completely running out of room, and there is a whole lot more to pack. From buying unclaimed storage containers to dumpster diving, Kristen says she cannot give up an opportunity to collect something that’s a good deal. But is there more to Kristen’s collecting than meets the eye? Find out the shocking reason Kristen says it is hard for her to part with her belongings. Plus, meet Kristen’s friends who say they are concerned that her “hoarding” is keeping their friend isolated.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Trying to blend two families can be like mixing oil and water. Dr. Phil sits down with couples struggling to merge their families and create happy, peaceful homes. Samantha and Rob are on the verge of divorce. She says Rob favors their 4-year-old son over her children from a previous marriage and is too hard on her kids when it comes to discipline. Rob feels his wife undermines him in their home. Can these two align and create a parenting plan that they both agree on? Then, with six kids between them, they may look like the Brady Bunch, but Pete and Maureen say their life is no sitcom. Pete says he and his wife can’t agree on how to raise each other’s kids, and every argument brings them closer to a divorce. And, meet a stepmom who says she can’t bond with her stepkids. Dr. Phil spells out the myths and facts of being a stepparent and the most successful way to fulfill that role. Plus, what is your parenting style?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Good fences make good neighbors, but Dr. Phil's guests say no matter how high the fence, they can't seem to end their vicious feud.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished finally faces her family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A woman who vanished reveals a dark secret.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Jessica, a mom of five, sent Dr. Phil a home video so disturbing it brought his wife, Robin, and many audience members to tears. Jessica admits that she’s angry all the time and says she struggles to parent her 7-year-old adopted son, Kristoff. She says she screams at the boy, puts hot sauce in his mouth and places him in a cold shower when he acts up. Attorney and child advocate Areva Martin weighs in. Then, several irate women in the audience give Jessica a piece of their mind.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever had one too many drinks and wondered what you look like? Or maybe you're one of those people who thinks no one could tell! See what happens when 30 people allow cameras to follow their every move as part of a drinking experiment.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Sarah and Tecoa's mother, Cindy, sits down with Dr. Phil to answer some hard questions about how her daughters' lives have spun so out of control. Dr. Phil shows her some of the video footage of Sarah's life on the street, selling her body, smoking crack cocaine and shooting heroin, while Tecoa explains how it all began. In a race against time, Dr. Phil gets the sisters off the streets and into The Dr. Phil House. Will Sarah and Tecoa commit to rehab and stay clean?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Just one day off heroin, Sarah is monitored medically as she goes through painful withdrawal symptoms. Tecoa has been clean for two weeks, but struggles with her own drug cravings while six months pregnant and providing support for her detoxing sibling. Is she sabotaging Dr. Phil's efforts to get Sarah healthy? Dr. Phil shows Sarah and Tecoa a terrifying look into their future. Is it enough to scare them straight?

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil addresses Cindy's impact on Tecoa's sobriety and reunites Sarah and Tecoa with their estranged father.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Victims and survivors of Jeffrey Dahmer say they want people to see him for who he really was -- not the glamorized TV version. See a never-before-aired interview with Dahmer’s father and stepmother that sheds light on the monster behind the man. They provide chilling details about his bizarre childhood behaviors. Plus, the Netflix series Dahmer - Monster: The Jeffrey Dahmer Story pushed a decades-old story into today’s spotlight, some say giving it a 2022 “pop culture moment.” After the series debuted, Dahmer’s infamous glasses went up for sale for $150,000, and people dressed up as the notorious serial killer for Halloween. Has our culture’s obsession with true crime desensitized us?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A possession is something we own, like a house, a car, or a new pair of shoes. But what happens when someone you know and love considers you their possession?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Do you have a man in your life who stomps his feet, pouts, whines and acts like a toddler? A bride-to-be is dealing with an immature fiance and a meddling mother-in-law, and a mooching groom is living in his mom's basement with his common-law wife and baby. Today's guests are grown men whose loved ones want them to grow up!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues speaking with a family who claims they were torn apart because of an organization that professes love. Amy says she is “Mother God” and can heal the world with her group, Love Has Won. Her sister Chelsea does not think Amy is a deity, but alleges that she is a brainwashed “cult leader” who abandoned her family years ago and is putting other people’s lives at risk.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The conversation continues with a woman who claims she is "Mother God."

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Cindy and Jim say they are fed up with their 35-year-old son, Brandon. They say he’s a moocher who refuses to get job, wears superhero costumes on a daily basis, and has caused $15,000 in damages to their property. Brandon says his parents don’t understand how his mind works. He admits to wearing superhero costumes and going on nightly “Batman” vigilante missions. Brandon says he also created a rapper persona named “Ceeza Caprice” and considers himself a “God MC” who can rap to any beat. Brandon’s sister, Harmony, says she blames her parents for Brandon’s behavior. She says they enable Brandon. She claims Brandon is a manipulator who sees it as a challenge to live off others.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine if out of the blue, your spouse tells you he or she doesn’t want to be married anymore. Then you realize your partner is nearly 50 years old, is getting in shape, updating his or her wardrobe and joining Facebook! Is this a midlife crisis? Dr. Phil sits down with two couples who are on the brink of divorce. Tony and Jill have been married for four years, but Tony says he wants out, so he can have his freedom back and not have the pressure and responsibility of having a wife. Their divorce will be final in a few weeks -- so why is Jill still sleeping with him? And, Miles says his wife of 10 years, Elaine, is going through a midlife crisis and that’s the reason why she’s had an affair. Elaine says she doesn’t regret her indiscretions because the other man made her feel happy and alive. Is there hope for these unions? Find out the warning signs of a midlife crisis and what Dr. Phil says these couples must do before calling it quits!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Domestic battles are never fun. But what happens when battling becomes a lifestyle? Today's guests want to learn how to put an end to their family feud once and for all.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Where is 7-year-old Kyron Horman? The little boy vanished six years ago without a trace after his school science fair. His parents claim his stepmother, Terri, knows what happened to him. Terri Horman tells her side of the story.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Pat, his wife Sarah and his father John, who Pat claims is delusional, paranoid and a threat to his family. John, on the other hand, says he is convinced that Pat and Sarah are a threat to his and his wife’s lives. Pat and Sarah say they want a relationship but claim every attempt is misconstrued by John as some form of life-threatening conspiracy theory. Can Dr. Phil help this family reunite and patch their volatile relationship? And, Pat Smith, wife of retired Dallas Cowboys running back Emmitt Smith, joins Dr. Phil to discuss her new book, Second Chances. In this very intimate publication, Pat shares her journey from loss to redemption, her setbacks and recoveries, and how to let go of what’s holding you back, reinvent your life and rediscover purpose and joy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Six months ago, Ed revealed to his wife of 12 years that he'd been having an affair. That news was shocking enough, but shortly after he dropped another bombshell: The mistress is pregnant.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After 12 years of marriage, Ed revealed to Kandi that he'd been having an affair and his mistress is now pregnant. Dr. Phil continues his in-depth look at the anatomy of an affair.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: He’s a tough-guy afraid of loosing his freedom. She’s been through two ugly divorces. So when the “M” word comes up, they head for the hills. Join these commitment-challenged singles as Dr. Phil uncovers the reasons why they won’t take the plunge. You’ll also meet a man who, after a four years in a loving relationship, doesn’t see the need to get married. To him it’s just a piece of paper. To her it’s a lot more. Find out if it’s really a “deal breaker.”

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Every day, many teen girls fear for their lives because of obsessive, controlling and abusive boyfriends, and it’s another reason why Dr. Phil is so passionate about his campaign to End the Silence on Domestic Violence. Seventeen-year-old Samantha sent an urgent plea for help to Dr. Phil. She says her ex-boyfriend, Aaron, called her nonstop for weeks and sent her threatening text messages after she broke up with him. After Samantha changed her number, he began calling her mother repeatedly. Samantha says he showed up unannounced at her house and pounded on the door for 45 minutes while she cowered in a locked closet. She says she’s afraid Aaron could even kill her. Dr. Phil sits down with the two teens to help Samantha get her message to Aaron loud and clear. And, Tiffany, 20, has a cautionary tale of survival every teen needs to hear. It could save her life!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: A mom wants to be a better parent. A wife can’t get her husband off the couch. A husband that just can’t seem to please his finicky wife. What do all these people have in common? Dr. Phil gives them what they need to put their lives back on track in the “How To…” episode. No matter what the issue or situation, we all share problems that keep us from leader a happier, healthier life. Tune in and find yourself in our courageous guests as they face their own battles with the help of Dr. Phil McGraw. Appointment television you won’t want to miss.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Some moms don't want to grow up, and others don't want to grow old. Dr. Phil talks to women walking on the wild side and tries to rein them back in!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Seven years ago, Brandon was an out-of-control drug addict, until his LIVE intervention on the Dr. Phil stage led him down the path to sobriety. Now clean for five years, Brandon and his mother, Debbie, pay it forward by helping other families confront their loved ones about their destructive addictions. A family desperate to save their three drug-addicted brothers: Sean, 28, Jordan, 24, and Logan, 23, reaches out to Brandon and Debbie for help. It’s an unpredictable event fraught with issues. Don’t miss this dramatic triple intervention!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you're suffering through difficult economic times and looking for ways to save money, get out your pen and paper and start taking notes! Dr. Phil's guests offer real tips to help you save money on clothes, utilities and vacations. Plus, learn how to cut your grocery bill in half and how to entertain your family on the cheap.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil talks to controlling, combative, outspoken guests whose loved ones want them off their back! First up, Tia demands perfection from her kids in school, music and sports. She's even picked out the perfect bride for her 14-year-old son! Then, he’s been called “the worst husband in Dr. Phil history!” When Deanna and Mike last appeared on Dr. Phil, Mike shocked the nation when he told his wife to “shut her suck hole!” He even tells her how to brush her teeth and take showers. Now they are back! Find out how their relationship has changed, and what will happen if Mike’s old habits re-appear!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, made headlines and were the subject of a Lifetime movie called Baby Brokers. The couple was accused of scamming would-be parents out of thousands of dollars by promising them one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Frankie says he and Karen had 10 children, and he claims eight of those children were placed for adoption without his knowledge. His daughters Sandy and Ava claim their biological father not only knew about the adoption scam, but they say they believe he was the mastermind behind it. What was Frankie’s involvement? Sandy claims her biological parents “sold her like a piece of furniture for $5,000.” Find out what happens when Sandy meets her biological father for the first time.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his conversation with Sandy and Ava, who confronted their biological father, Frankie, about his alleged involvement in an adoption scam. Sandy and Ava claim Frankie and his former wife, Karen Leanne Dees, “sold” their children in an adoption scam, where they promised prospective parents they could adopt one of their unborn babies in exchange for financial support. Their brother, Dalton, says he was Frankie and Karen’s ninth child who was adopted. He claims his biological parents put a $3,000 price tag on his head and that he was the last child “sold” before his mother was arrested. Plus, meet one of the prospective parents who adopted one of Karen’s children. Find out why she says Frankie belongs behind bars. And, Frankie’s youngest child, Ava, says she was raised by her father after her mother was arrested by the FBI -- but she says she did not have a better life than her siblings. Find out a dark secret Ava reveals about her father, and why she wants him to take a polygraph test. What happens when Dr. Phil offers Frankie the opportunity to take a polygraph test?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his interview with Tommy, who accuses his ex-wife, Julia, and her new husband, Codey, of killing his 19-month-old son, Darby, and 4-year-old stepdaughter, Kiera -- an allegation the couple vehemently deny. Dr. Phil enlists the help of forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht to examine the children’s autopsy reports -- what are his findings? And, will Julia and Codey agree to take polygraph tests?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How far would you go to find the love of your life? Kim says she’s turned over every rock to find her soul mate – even cruising prisons for a single guy! She says she tries to land a man by sleeping with him on the first date. Her friend, Tracey, says Kim needs to raise her standards, because she exudes desperation. Find out what Dr. Phil male staffers think about Kim’s dating habits. Then, Todd says he’s looking for the perfect woman, and she must be the total package: tall, blonde, model looks, a size 38DD bust and no baggage. Will he learn to stop seeking the superficial? Plus, meet a man who made headlines when he posted a billboard advertisement for a girlfriend, and a woman who admits to stalking her estranged husband to get him back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Paul was his family’s rock and role model, so when he suddenly passed away, his wife and four children say their lives were shattered. Debbie, who was married to Paul for 30 years, says she shut down after his death and doesn’t know how to unite her brood. Sisters Jamie, Erica and Tayler say they don’t know how to properly grieve, they’re always fighting with each other, and they’re upset that their brother, Paul, turned his back on them. Paul says he didn’t run away from his loved ones; he has his own family and says he feels stretched thin. Find out the secret Erica’s been keeping that threatens to throw everyone into further turmoil, and hear the final wish Jamie’s dad had for her. If you’re grappling with grief after the loss of a relative, learn how to find closure and peace.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Former high school dance teacher Anne, 35, made national headlines when it was revealed that her two children -- ages 3 and 2 -- were fathered by Bradman, a former student who is 14 years her junior. Bradman, now 21, is claiming that their physical relationship began when he was 15 and that Anne made the first move. Facing possible prison time on two felony charges, Anne turns to Dr. Phil to tell her side of the story. Why does she believe that she is the victim? And, why does she say she filed a protective order against Bradman? Then, Bradman takes the stage to tell his side of the story. Why does he say he didn't reveal the nature of their relationship sooner? And, why is he coming forward now? It's a don't miss Dr. Phil!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: How has the role of the man evolved in the modern family? One woman claims her husband provides her with everything—except love and affection. He says he only knows how to provide financially. Can Dr. Phil help them find a balance and save their marriage of 17 years? Then, one guest entered into a new relationship after leaving his wife and kids. Now, his guilt is causing him to lie, manipulate and become physically abusive. Find out what Dr. Phil has to say to these men about the true measure of a man’s success in a relationship!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Millions were inspired by the first “Role of the Man” show. Now, Dr. Phil is making it an ongoing series and checking in with past guests. Remember the husband who provided everything for his wife…except intimacy? He’s back! Are they now sleeping in the same bed? Then, you’ll hear from the man who wanted his wife to have sex with him on demand. Did he change his selfish ways or is he still in the doghouse? Plus, what’s a mama’s boy to do when his wife insists he cut the umbilical cord once and for all?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What do you do when life’s problems seem so overwhelming that it feels like there’s no way out? Kenny, who was one of the first responders to the 9/11 tragedy, says he still struggles with post-traumatic stress disorder and other health challenges. His wife, Cyndi, and daughter, Gina, say he just sits on the couch and obsesses about that fateful day, and they feel he needs to get over it. Can Kenny get his life and his health back? Then, Steve and Jacki have been married for four years, and Steve says he’s at a crossroads in his relationship. He says his wife puts him last and moved her elderly parents into their home while he was on the road. Jacki says she can’t get over her husband’s insensitivity to her dying mother, and isn’t sure if their relationship can be saved. Is it time for Steve to say enough is enough and move on?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with some opinionated guests! Can he get them to see that their opinions and judgments can be hurtful?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil looks into the nature of passive aggressive and pessimistic behaviors. One wife needs Dr. Phil’s help dealing with her passive aggressive husband. He never tells her what he’s thinking and often leaves to avoid confrontation. She says this punishment is hurtful and has their marriage in serious jeopardy. Plus, meet a college student whose negativity is alienating her from friends and potential boyfriends. Tune in for Dr. Phil’s cure for this bad case of bad attitude.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: If you or someone you know is pregnant, then you won’t want to miss today’s show! This episode is the first in a new series on pregnancy. Dr. Phil shares what they don’t tell you to expect when you’re expecting. Parents-to-be, Morgan and Shannon both have Type A personalities. She’s obsessed about her weight. He’s a neat freak. How can they prepare for an unpredictable lifestyle as parents? Then, tag along as they visit a daddy boot camp and a pregnancy gym. Plus, does carrying low mean you’re having a boy? An expert will help you sort out the truth from the myths when it comes to pregnancy.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: In part two of “Profiles of a Pregnancy,” Dr. Phil tackles common decisions couples face during the 40-week roller coaster ride of pregnancy. One father-to-be refuses to be in the delivery room when his wife goes into labor; but she wants him by her side. Will this squeamish husband take Dr. Phil’s advice or will he opt for the waiting room? Then, Dr. Phil checks back with new parents-to-be Shannon and Morgan to see how they’re progressing. Plus, Robin surprises the couple with a brand new nursery!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s been three years since Glenn Lemoine’s body was found floating in a canal, and his death remains a mystery. His family wants answers -- and they’re pointing the finger at each other. Two agree to take polygraph tests -- what will the results reveal?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Although New Year’s day has already come and gone, Dr. Phil’s going to give you the keys to sticking with this year’s resolutions. You’ll meet three women all battling to keep their New Year’s promise to themselves, and through them you’ll learn how to recognize what’s keeping you from becoming the person you’ve always wanted to be. Whether it’s to quit smoking, lose weight or get your finances in shape, it’s time to stop making excuses and start getting results.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The art of negotiating to get your kids to do anything begins the moment they are born. If you're tired of playing "Let's Make a Deal" with your children when it's time to eat, get dressed or go to sleep, Dr. Phil has advice.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Stay-at-home mom Jessica claims her soon-to-be ex-husband of 23 years, Mike, is a narcissist who controls everything in her and their teenage daughters’ lives, especially the finances. Sixteen-year-old Chloe and 18-year-old Zoey say the worst thing he did was to shatter their dreams of becoming professional dancers in New York City. But Mike claims Jessica is putting the girls in the middle of their fight and brainwashing them to hate him. Dr. Phil tells Mike and Jessica what every couple needs to do with children when their marriage falls apart.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dennis Quaid joins Dr. Phil to discuss his new movie, “Yours, Mine and Ours". In this family comedy, single parents Frank (Dennis Quaid) and Helen (Rene Russo) plan to tie the knot… but with 18 children between them trying to sabotage the marriage, they discover that weddings – and families – can’t be built in a day. Then, meet a real-life blended family whose battles are tearing them apart. Arguments over space, chores, and discipline make it feel like a war zone for two families trying to blend under one roof. Dr. Phil gives advice to this Brady Bunch gone wild!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sisters Rylie, 23, and Lenae, 26, claim their father, Leonard, was extremely physically and verbally abusive during their childhood and that they lived in constant fear of him — allegations he absolutely denies. They also claim their mother, Susan, did not protect them from him. Rylie claims the alleged abuse was so damaging that she believes it’s the cause of her diagnosis of Borderline Personality Disorder. Lenae says the many years of alleged verbal abuse have led to self-loathing and even an eating disorder. Leonard admits to having a tough disciplinary style, but refutes his daughters accusations — even saying they’ve blown everything out of proportion.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Richie Lewis was a three-time All-American, Hall of Fame college pitcher, who became one of Major League Baseball’s most electric personalities, striking out some of the game’s greatest players. But now, his wife Andrea and their three children claim since Richie was forced to retire from the majors due to an injury, Richie says his life has no purpose without baseball and he has no reason to live. Richie’s family claims his depression and alcoholism have led him to become a sloppy, blackout and abusive drunk, who has become a public embarrassment to himself and his family. Richie insists the only issue he is facing is depression from leaving the game he loved. Before coming to Dr. Phil, Richie demanded no one discuss his alleged alcoholism, and he threatened to walk out of their lives forever if they did not honor his demand. What happens when Richie finds out he is indeed part of an alcohol intervention? Plus, Richie’s college teammate Deion Sanders drops everything to fly to Los Angeles to surprise and help his dear friend. Will all this effort convince Richie that he needs help?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The saga of a father's quest for his vanished daughter is discussed.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Lisa says her four beautiful adult daughters, Brandi, Wendi, Laci and Tahni, are "monsters" who pick on her, and their constant drama is tearing apart their family. However, all four daughters say it's Lisa who needs help. They claim she's a "textbook narcissist" who constantly plays the victim and has always put men before her family. Who is in the wrong here? Will Dr. Phil be able to bring this family back together?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: What would you do if you were standing at the altar in your wedding gown, holding a bridal bouquet in a room full of family and friends ... and the groom didn’t show up? Would you seek revenge? That’s what Dr. Phil’s first guest, Dee, says she did. She says she spent over $31,000 on her special day only to be dumped by her then-fiancé, Danny. He says there’s more to the story than meets the eye. Dee and Danny haven’t seen each other in more than two years. Find out what happens when they face off on Dr. Phil’s stage and what Dee says she did to get even! And, Laurel says that while her ex-boyfriend, Brad Womack, was living life on TV as “The Bachelor,” he continued to send her text messages asking her to marry him. Brad has denied her claims in print, but Laurel says she wants to set the record straight. Plus, Dr. Phil checks back in with Marilyn, who says her fiancé left her with a big bill just six days before the wedding. When Marilyn first appeared on the show, she feared that she would never be able to trust men again. See her amazing update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Their job is to protect you. They won't let you walk down the street alone. They call your house five times a day, screen your calls, monitor your every move. No, it's not the government or the F.B.I., it's mothers! Is there such a thing as a mom having too much love for her child? Dr. Phil puts Mom to the test!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his intervention with Jamie, a fitness model who admits he has struggled with drug and alcohol addiction for years. Jamie’s brother, Anthony, says their parents have enabled Jamie at every turn -- including failing to acknowledge Jamie’s other serious problem, which he refuses to discuss. After storming off stage, Jamie rejoins the conversation. Is he ready to be completely honest with his family -- and with himself? Dr. Phil has a sobering wake-up call for Jamie -- and for his parents. Will Jamie finally get the help he needs to get clean -- and stay clean for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Aja says she is sick and tired of taking care of her ungrateful, entitled, drug-addicted mother, Janet. Aja says she has allowed her mom to live with her for eight of the 10 years of her marriage. Aja claims she’s spent $100,000 taking care of her mom and that she does absolutely everything for her without any appreciation. Janet rejects Aja’s claim that she is somehow taking advantage of Aja. She says she pays rent, regularly goes to Narcotics Anonymous, so what else does Aja want from her? Aja says she’s glad her mom has made improvements, but it doesn’t make up for her and her older sister, Ashley’s, neglected childhood. Aja claims they were put in constant danger and surrounded by violent criminals and firearms. But Janet says, “I think my past drug addiction has made my girls the women they are today.” Will Aja finally give her mother the boot? Can this family possibly come together after years of animosity? Find out!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Heather and Chris say their six-year marriage is on the brink of divorce because of their constant heated arguments, which they admit happen almost daily, in front of their two young children. Heather, a stay-at-home mom, says Chris is so controlling that he constantly accuses her of cheating on him, checks her phone records to see whom she’s calling and won’t let her handle their finances. Chris says Heather is only with him for the money and has gotten violent with him during their disagreements -- some of which have been caught on tape. He says she has kicked him in the privates, slapped him in the face and thrown a tape measure at his head -- all in front of the kids. What’s driving the couple’s anger? Plus, Chris recently filed for divorce -- will he change his mind and agree to work on their marriage? Then, Kerry says she and her husband, Sam, engage in explosive fighting at least four times a week, and she fears someone will get seriously hurt. Can this couple learn to fight fairly? This program contains strong language. Viewer discretion advised.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil explores a disturbing trend: Female teachers engaging in sex acts with their underage male students. The number of accusations has doubled in the past five years. You've probably heard of famous cases like Mary Kay Letourneau, Debra Lafave and the recent case of a teacher in Southern California, Meredith Johnson Vincent, who was arrested on suspicion of having a sexual relationship with a 14-year-old boy. Dr. Phil meets one teacher who has chosen to fight back.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his look at a teacher sex scandal that has a school and families divided in a small town in Texas. High school teacher Joelle Ogletree faces accusations of sexual misconduct with some of her male students. Hear both sides of this gripping sex scandal from the accuser and the accused, and judge for yourself if justice has been served.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil speaks with women who say they feel forgotten by their loved ones because of their excessive weight. Lorna weighs 650-plus pounds and feels abandoned by her family. Lorna’s sister, Glenice, says Lorna got herself into this situation; now she has to take responsibility and get herself out. Lorna’s boyfriend, Blair, takes care of her, but Glenice says he’s not the Mr. Nice Guy he appears to be. She says he's really an abuser. Lorna says Blair is exhausted and stressed from the hard job of caring for her, and her family needs to help rather than drive him away. Is Lorna ready to stop accepting the abuse and start accepting help? Then, Sunni weighs almost 300 pounds and wants to pursue her dream of being a plus-size model. Her boyfriend, Christian, however, says she’s too fat for the runway, and she should leave that dream to the skinny girls. Sunni says she is big and fabulous, and Christian makes her feel like she should crawl under a rock. Will Sunni be forced to pick between her relationship and her dream? Dr. Phil has some surprises for Sunni.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Does your child lie, steal, swear, or test you daily? Karen and Matt's son is only 4 years old, but he’s already cursing! Patty and Eric's 8-year-old son has been stealing since kindergarten. Now, they’re worried this could lead to a life of crime. Plus, a boy whose nickname is Dracula because he’s always biting somebody! And, what if you kept finding your 4-year-old in his birthday suit with the little girl next door? Beverly and Shea say they can't figure out why their kids like to get naked and play.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The family of 19-year-old Jake Limberios continues to search for answers surrounding his death in March 2012. Who fired the gunshot that ended his life? Brittany and Will, who witnessed the shooting, say Jake, a gun enthusiast, accidentally shot himself in the head. Although the coroner ruled his death a suicide, Jake’s parents, Mike and Shannon, say their son, a young father, never would’ve taken his own life. Left with so many unanswered questions, Jake’s parents had his body exhumed and autopsied by renowned forensic pathologist Dr. Cyril Wecht, who concluded that Jake’s cause of death wasn’t suicide. Dr. Phil speaks with Dr. Wecht via satellite -- hear why he says Jake couldn’t have shot himself. Plus, Brittany and Will say they sympathize with Jake’s parents but are tired of being under suspicion and agree to take polygraph tests to prove they’re not hiding any details about Jake’s death. What will the results reveal? And, Mike and Shannon say their marriage has grown strained since their son’s death -- can they learn to come together and find peace after such a painful loss?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nearly 20 years after graduation, Dr. Phil's guests say they can't shake their high school image and are striving to overcome their deeply rooted insecurities. Plus, Dr. Phil reveals the common characteristics of victims of bullies.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues the story of a mother who says she lives in fear every day that her 18-year-old daughter, Katherine, could be killed by a man she met on the Internet.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Meleah and Greg's young love story started and ended like so many. But when Meleah discovered she was pregnant following their breakup, their lives became forever intertwined. Watch as sparks fly when they face off! Plus, Paige was a teen mom struggling to make ends meet. You won't want to miss her remarkable update!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil rings in 2005 with a “New Year’s Resolutions Week” to help you make changes that really matter! Today he helps tackle the number one issue couples fight about – Money! Eris and Vivian spend so much on designer clothes, they cut out costs that really matter - like groceries! They’ve filed for bankruptcy once, have a home in foreclosure, are more than $28,000 in debt…and they still can’t stop shopping! Thai and CJ live paycheck-to-paycheck and even started to sell their kids' old clothes on eBay just to make ends meet. Dr. Phil has some action plans that can help them and you reach your goals.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Addiction, a disastrous condition that takes on other forms than drugs and alcohol. On today’s episode you’ll meet a “work-a-holic,” “food-a-holic” and “shop-a-holic.” Listen up as Dr. Phil gets to the real reasons behind his guests’ addictive behaviors. As Dr. Phil puts it, “Addiction serves a purpose.” Witness their dramatic revelations when the issues driving their compulsive behavior are uncovered, and learn what it will take to get their habits under control.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: It’s been more than three years since 7-year-old Kyron Horman disappeared -- and the case still remains unsolved. Kyron’s divorced parents, Desiree and Kaine, come together in an exclusive interview with Dr. Phil. Hear why they say they believe Kyron’s stepmother, Terri, may know more that she’s admitting.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Two families desperate to find their missing children ask Dr. Phil for help. Two-year-old Bianca disappeared while in the care of her father. He says she was taken when he was carjacked. Was he involved in her disappearance? And, Josh hasn’t seen his son, Trenton, since he was 2 years old, more than five years ago. Did the boy's mother, who died by suicide, take clues with her to the grave?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Gypsy Willis- the former mistress of a doctor convicted of murdering his wife- speaks out.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: The mother/daughter relationship can take many forms: best friends, parent-child, and in the case of today’s guests, adversaries. You’ll meet one mom who’s driving her daughter crazy with constant phone calls and unexpected visits. Are her actions creating the separation she fears most? Find out how another mom’s money mismanagement has her daughter feeling both financially and emotionally at risk. Moms, daughters and trust - on the next Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Are we raising a generation of ungrateful children? Melissa’s sisters say her sons are the most spoiled boys in North America. They get everything they want – all they have to do is whine. Melissa says her kids just like toys, and she thinks her sisters may be jealous of her lifestyle. Next, Dori admits that her 13-year-old son, Parker, is spoiled. Parker says he won't take no for an answer, and even has a strategy for getting everything he wants. Find out what's behind Dori's need to spoil Parker. Then, Joan says her 14-year-old daughter, Jacquie, is a snob, and her need for trendy clothes is turning her into a materialistic monster. Plus, Lauren spends her entire paycheck shopping, but with no money in her checking account, she’s afraid she could be headed for trouble. Her mom, Diane, says she's not worried, it's just Lauren's way of relaxing.

programme.title: Dr.Phil
programme.desc: One of the most asked-about guests, Brandon, returns with an update.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Morgan and Ashley claim their mom, Treva, is “a toxic, violent alcoholic,” who they say is way out of control, and that although she’s been to rehab eight times, she’s never stayed sober. In the past year, Morgan says the police have been called to the house 57 times for violence, threats, assault and even arson. Morgan says if her mom doesn’t stop her excessive drinking and end the violence, she will walk away for good. Treva says she does not want to go to another “dumb treatment center” as she is “done with them” and claims they do not work for her. Treva has said that she believes the problem is 10% her and 90% everyone else – and that she believes her family needs an intervention.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Being a single mother is hard enough, but imagine juggling soccer practice, PTA meetings and homework ... all while trying to cover up a secret life. Susan is a single mom with two kids who works as a prostitute to pay the bills. She says she's never had a real job and is addicted to the money she makes as an escort. Can Susan ditch her dangerous job and turn her life around? Then, Stephanie is a single mother of four and has been hiding a secret for 12 years. She's addicted to painkillers and takes up to 60 times the recommended dosage just to make it through the day. Fearing for their lives and those of their children, the women turn to Dr. Phil.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: After a Tennessee mother caused an international uproar when she sent her 7-year-old adopted son on a one-way flight back to Russia, the subject of international adoptions is making front-page headlines. Dr. Phil speaks with moms who say they relate to the Tennessee woman, and unless you walk a mile in their shoes, you have no way of understanding. Jane says she had no idea her 2-year-old daughter, Mikhaela, was profoundly deaf and autistic when she adopted her from the Ukraine eight years ago. Jane says the 10-year-old has multiple behavioral disorders and kicks, bites, punches and tries to hurt herself daily, and is getting too strong for her to handle. And, Kristi says all the love in the world couldn’t have helped the baby girl she adopted from China. Kristi says she wasn’t even close to being qualified to parent her now 14-year-old daughter, Tierney, who lives in a behavioral foster home in order to keep Kristi’s other children safe. If you’re thinking of adopting internationally, or if you’re an adoptive parent in crisis, don’t miss today’s show. Learn how to prepare for a cross-cultural adoption, how to get through the adoption process the correct way and what the experts have to say.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil continues his series on how to survive inflation. Today, financial experts share money-saving and money-making tips to help you learn how to take control of your finances during inflation. Plus, find out the best ways to use money to make money, savings hacks, freebie secrets, and get advice on how to set up the next generation for financial success.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Have you ever hidden cash or a bill from your spouse? Do you think your partner is telling you the truth about his or her debt? A recent study found that one in three people admit that they lie to their spouses about money. Dr. Phil’s guest, Crystine, says she’s told her husband, Tom, so many lies, she can’t keep track of them, and she’s scared Tom will divorce her when he finds out the truth. Is Crystine ready to spill the beans about her money secrets and will she change her deceitful ways? And, Debbie admits she shopped herself into debt and out of her past three marriages. She says she could open a store with the amount of clothing and accessories she has in her house -- many with the tags still attached -- and can’t go two days without buying something new. Find out what happened 10 years ago that kick-started her urge to overspend. Her boyfriend, Ron, says their relationship can’t move forward until she gets her shopping under control. Are you guilty of financial infidelity? Find out how you compare to Dr. Phil’s studio audience as he polls them about their spending habits!

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Marcy and Scott say they believe their daughter, Danielle, has Stockholm syndrome from her boyfriend, Justin. They claim Justin is an abusive narcissist who has manipulated their daughter into believing he’s “God’s gift to the world.” Danielle says she loves Justin, and he’s not going anywhere. She says the only reason Justin has ever laid hands on her is to restrain her from her own angry rages, and her parents don’t understand their relationship. Justin says he’s a great guy with an “X factor” and doesn’t understand why Danielle’s parents dislike him. Although he’s currently dealing with a serious legal problem, he says he’s not a criminal, narcissist, or an abuser. And, in a shocking twist, Danielle reveals to Dr.Phil and her parents a secret about her relationship with Justin.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is your household in turmoil? Do you feel overwhelmed by your child’s temper tantrums? Dr. Phil reveals the best solutions for common parenting dilemmas, and he has help from educational consultant Dr. Michele Borba. Lizette and Ricky have four children under age 6, and they say their 3-year-old daughter’s behavior is completely out of control. They say she hits, scratches, yells and screams, and her meltdowns are rubbing off on her siblings. Find out what happens when Dr. Borba makes a house call. Then, learn why Lizette says she left home for a month! Plus, Stefani and Shenan are engaged and struggling to blend their families. She has four kids and he has three, but when all seven of them are together, they say it’s utter madness! Dr. Phil and Dr. Borba have advice for keeping the peace.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Imagine finding your son passed out in his room with drug paraphernalia surrounding his body. When that happened to one mother, she made an important call for help. Dr. Phil’s son, Jay, was working with a family for his new reality show when the mom, Vikki, phoned to say that her son, Justin, had been using drugs. Dr. Phil made a surprise house call and insisted that the teen get help immediately. Find out what happens with Justin, and why Vikki thinks she's to blame for his drug use. Then, a stay-at-home mother of three was drinking bottles of wine and vodka every day -- she would even fill a sports drink bottle with alcohol and take it to her kids' school events. Did she break her deadly addiction?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: From a mom with a violent temper to feuding sisters with tearful recollections of childhood molestation, Dr. Phil checks back in with some of his most explosive guests from this season.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Is there someone in your life you just can’t stand? Wouldn’t life be easier if you could find a way to make peace? Dr. Phil speaks with people who often struggle to get along: the ex-wife and the stepmom. Jennifer and her ex-husband’s new wife, Carol, hated each other for two years, until one pivotal moment changed their relationship forever. Together, they wrote the book No One’s the Bitch, and offer the 10 steps to strengthening the stepfamily -- starting with the women. Then, Lori says she's had a tense and rocky relationship with her husband’s ex-wife, Stephanie, and says the past eight years have been difficult. Can Dr. Phil get these two women to negotiate a new relationship? Just what are the boundaries for a stepmother? There are 1,300 stepfamilies forming every day in the U.S. Learn what you can do to ensure a happy and healthy family.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil is addressing what he feels is a red alert crisis in America: drug and alcohol addiction, which affects 28 million addicts. Over the past 16 seasons, Dr. Phil has been able to help nearly 500 guests with inpatient treatment for substance abuse. Today, he will update some of their amazing recovery stories in hopes that they might inspire others who are struggling with addiction. Find out what happened to three sisters, Valeen, Amanda, and Tiffany, who were not only dangerously addicted to heroin, but also using it together every day. And what happen to Niki, who appeared on the show addicted, homeless, and pregnant? Niki returns to give her shocking update. Bethany said not even a medically induced coma and open heart surgery could get her to stop her dangerous heroin addiction -- find out how she’s doing now. Plus, numerous past guests and their families return to the Dr. Phil stage to share their amazing stories of recovery.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: More and more newlyweds are declaring their honeymoon is over and they're ready to call it quits. One wife feels she's not the only woman in her relationship. And, Dr. Phil follows up with Shamika and Marlon to see if they are getting their marriage back on track.

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Nineteen-year-old Cherylyn says she loves living the high life and admits she is a spoiled and entitled“princess”who has spent tens of thousands of other people’s money on her lavish lifestyle. Cherylyn says she maxed out her 19 credit cards on designer shoes, handbags, purses, clothes, makeup and pampering! And, Cherylyn says she insists on fine dining, fast cars and her boyfriend, Tyler, footing the bill. However, Tyler says he has nothing more to give Cherylyn except an ultimatum, which he delivers when he comes face-to-face with her onstage. Cherylyn's mom, Joey, says that her selfish and manipulative daughter has blown over $130,000 in less than a year and her spending has left a trail of devastation which includes pawning over $7,000 worth of family heirlooms and stealing her identity. Sparks fly when Cherylyn defends her entitled behavior during the taping. What jaw-dropping statement does an unrepentant Cherylyn make to Dr. Phil?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Sex is supposed to be a healthy, normal, natural intimacy that couples share. So why does it threaten to destroy these guests' relationships?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Many little girls dream of the perfect wedding day with a fairytale gown, beautiful flowers and their handsome groom, but Dr. Phil's guests say their wedding bells hit a sour note. Amy says the day she and Steve tied the knot turned into a disaster. The sun scorched the guests, then there was a downpour, the wedding arch fell and hit the pastor, and the cake crumbled as they were cutting it. She says it was a huge dream shattered, and she can't move past it. Steve says he had a blast, and Amy needs to lighten up. What does Dr. Phil think? Then, shortly after Mandy and her husband, Kris, said "I do," a three-story deck collapsed and they and 30 of their family and friends were seriously injured. Mandy says she left her wedding strapped to a stretcher, and she and Kris spent their wedding night in the emergency room. Although this took place over two years ago, the couple thinks about it every day. How can they overcome their guilt? And, Kurt and Brandi recently renewed their vows because they say they wanted a fresh start to their seven-year marriage. Just months after their ceremony, Kurt filed for divorce when he found out a secret Brandi had been keeping. Will the results of polygraph tests inspire this couple to make their marriage work or end it for good?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Dr. Phil’s guests say they’re devastated by a childhood trauma, and they want to confront the parent who they say caused it. First, Mandy says she hates her mother, Becky, for abducting her when she was a child, changing her name and keeping her in hiding for two years over allegations of abuse. Becky says she doesn’t regret going on the run with her daughter, and she’d do it again. The pair has only seen each other once in the past 22 years. Is it too late to start over? Then, Butch says his father, Ulysses, stole his childhood. He confronts his father for the first time in 33 years to find out why he killed his mother. Butch was just 12 years old and says he remembers every moment of that day, including being used to get his mother to come back into the house after his parents’ fight. Ulysses says the "unfortunate incident" was an accident, and he wants to make things right with his son before he dies. Will Butch get the answers he’s searching for and accept his father’s apology?

programme.title: Dr. Phil
programme.desc: Think you’re ready to say, “I do?”… not so fast! Dr. Phil puts 3 newly engaged couples to the test in his Premarital Boot Camp series, with real-life challenges like parenting, fighting, money, and sex. Find out what happens when one couple leaves their “baby” unattended six times and why another couple has to do some major explaining to the California Highway Patrol. Will they all make it to the altar… and who will win big prizes?
